items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday vs. Panthers; Will Shipley also to IR. Lengthy Eagles injury list.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practices; official Friday ruling.
items.implication: Eagles RB depth thin; expect heavier committee or lead for remaining backs in low-total game with Hurts also OUT.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down work shifts to available PHI RBs; reverse any prior Saquon start assumptions.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Rams; will rest ailing ankle for long-term healing. No IR plans.
items.implication: ARI backfield opens further; monitor remaining RBs and MHJ trade fallout on offense.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/routes for ARI RBs behind Love; check depth chart elevation.

items.text: Ravens ruled out QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) for Sunday at Cleveland; third straight day of no practice, Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Left ankle sprain; missed all practices this week.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens offense volume may hold but efficiency/ceiling drops for pass-catchers vs CLE.
items.opportunity: Monitor Zay Flowers/Mark Andrews usage under Huntley; prior Huntley starts averaged high points.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) again for Sunday vs Patriots; third straight miss. Adonai Mitchell also OUT.
items.implication: Braelon Allen continues as lead back with heavy snap share.
items.opportunity: Allen 90+ snaps in prior full games without Hall; clear RB1 workload vs NE.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs removed from Commissioner Exempt list Monday; expected eligible Week 7. Investigation remains open. Similar for Broncos' Jonathon Cooper (eligible W7).
items.why: NFL removing from list; rights reserved for further discipline.
items.implication: GB RB room normalizes W7+; short-term handcuff/backup value elevated this week only.
items.opportunity: Monitor GB depth (Lloyd etc.) for W6 only spike.

items.text: It is possible AJ Brown returns this week (ankle, IR window); status 'up in the air' per player. Patriots list him questionable. Berry notes relief for fantasy managers.
items.implication: If active, immediate high-end WR start; monitor final designation closely.
items.opportunity: Target share spike if cleared; NE offense upgrade.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams (hamstring) officially questionable after another full practice Friday; chance to return vs Falcons.
items.why: Hamstring; full participant multiple days but needs clearance.
items.implication: If active, major upgrade for CHI pass-catchers (Odunze/Burden/Loveland) and implied total.
items.opportunity: Monitor Saturday/Sunday; full practice signals likely play or GTD.

items.text: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) has no injury designation and is expected to start vs Bears.
items.why: Off injury report after full practice.
items.implication: Stabilizes ATL offense; boosts Drake London and run game vs CHI.
items.opportunity: Full starter snaps/routes for London et al.

items.text: Levitan notes RB snaps in two full games since Breece Hall injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Hall remains week-to-week/no practice.
items.why: Clear hierarchical snap data without Hall.
items.implication: Allen locked as every-down back while Hall out; strong W6 play.
items.opportunity: Near-monopoly snaps/carries/routes for Allen; handcuff elevated.

items.text: Levitan: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins/McNabb/McCoy/Ertz). Saquon turns 30 in Feb; if Super Bowl contender with RB need, at least call. Agrees risk of moving year early better than late in this case.
items.why: Age curve + PHI history of proactive moves; current hamstring absence.
items.implication: ROS trade value caution even post-return; contenders may inquire.
items.opportunity: Monitor PHI depth chart and any trade rumors; short-term OUT already priced.

items.text: Berry LOVES Mike Evans as his WR4 this week vs Commanders secondary; soft matchup for pass catchers.
items.why: Washington defense buffet for WRs; Evans ranked WR4.
items.implication: Strong start signal in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: High target/route volume expected vs weak secondary.

items.text: Berry LOVES Drake London (WR6) vs CHI; bankable usage with Penix back.
items.implication: Core WR2/3 start with elevated floor.
items.opportunity: Target share locked in with starter QB healthy.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kyren Williams (RB5) vs ARI; elite recent usage vs run-leaking defense. Also loves Javonte Williams (RB8 goal-line) and Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9).
items.why: Volume + soft run defenses; Kyren elite usage, Javonte GL role.

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA tough matchup), Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts; also HATES Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA elite pass D) and Justin Herbert (low total @ KC).
items.why: Ugly matchups, shaky QB situations, low scoring environments.
items.opportunity: Reduced expected targets/efficiency; Nix historically timid per Berry.
